question: Does selecting visible passage IDs before answering improve complete answers over format-matched direct supervision?
rationale: V22 found unsupported cited relations and cross-step entity collisions. Pointer targets avoid supervising intermediate factual assertions or repeating a last-step answer claim. Author support annotations remain imperfect; this tests a new recipe, not a causal explanation of V21.
replication_rule: Only if the frozen pilot primary gate and plan-integrity gate pass; repeat the SAME frozen protocol and terminal evaluation. No prompt/data/loss changes between seeds. No two-seed success claim before replication.

training.source: The unchanged ordered V21 TRAIN2048 question cohort, projected into new targets without canonical decomposition text
training.precision: BF16 active parameters/gradients; FP32 masters and Adam states
training.view_schedule: For BOTH arms, direct if (fixed_item_index + epoch) is even, selection otherwise. Every item has two of each view; both views appear within each epoch.
training.loss: 0.5 mean source CE + 0.5 mean final-answer-field CE + 0.1 mean selection-field CE; each component normalized separately per example, then averaged over examples. Absent selection field contributes zero.
training.answer_coefficient_contract: For each question, the final field, answer and sampled EOS have exactly the same native labels and per-token loss coefficient in every view and arm. Selection length cannot dilute them.
training.matching_limits: Same questions, order, views, updates, packed shape and source/final-answer coefficients. Selection targets and useful supervised-token counts differ. This is not exact FLOP/gradient equivalence or a loss-only ablation of V21.

serialization.input: Only authored question and every visible title/text paragraph; mode instruction is fixed and contains no support, answer, hop-count or decomposition metadata.
serialization.indices: Unique one-based visible paragraph IDs, ascending document order, from author support annotations; no subquestions or intermediate answer strings.
serialization.parser: The existing anchored Final answer field parser in prior mode for EVERY response, including direct responses. No first-line fallback or gold-dependent recovery.
serialization.generation: One native greedy causal response, max128 new actions for both arms; terminate at a complete answer line or sampled EOS. All caps, unsupported plans/answers and errors retained.
serialization.plan_diagnostics: Check syntax, unique in-range IDs, annotated support precision/recall, actual actions and source overlap. Correct IDs do not establish semantic entailment or connected reasoning.

fresh_panel.source: Previously acquired author MuSiQue TRAIN only; official DEV/TEST remain unopened
fresh_panel.exclude: Old TRAIN/held question IDs and normalized questions; candidate support paragraph/title must be absent from ALL old TRAIN-visible AND old held-visible paragraphs/titles; original single-hop IDs absent from both cohorts.
fresh_panel.within_panel: Support paragraph/title, original single-hop IDs and normalized questions are pairwise disjoint. Repeated answers allowed; not the official S5 split and not evidence of pretraining novelty.
fresh_panel.selection: Build candidate conflict degrees using only these metadata. Fixed hash salt document-evidence-plan-v23-fresh-held-v1. First greedily select32 candidates with >=3 hops in (-hops, conflict-degree, hash) order; then fill to256 in (conflict-degree, hash) order without conflicts. If either quota fails, publish failure and do not release training; do not silently relax filters or retune the cohort.
fresh_panel.depth_limit: Only seven four-hop candidates survive these exclusions before independence filtering. Depth-specific outcomes are descriptive; no four-hop generalization claim.
fresh_panel.old_held512: Development/history only; cannot rescue a failed fresh-panel result. No model-output inspection on the new panel before protocol, masks, parser and endpoints are frozen.

evaluation.primary: Canonical complete-answer EM on all256 fresh questions: evidence_select native selection minus evidence_direct direct response.
evaluation.pilot_primary_gate: Point gain >=3 percentage points AND 95% paired question-bootstrap lower bound >0; 20000 resamples, seed2026101923, conditional on the terminal checkpoints.
evaluation.plan_integrity_gate: At least95% of evidence_select selection outputs contain a single valid Evidence field with unique in-range IDs. This is a serialization/mechanism condition, not a semantic correctness certificate.
required_controls: evidence_direct under the selection instruction, trained to emit an empty Evidence field
evidence_select under its ordinary direct-answer instruction
evidence_select with a supplied empty Evidence field
evidence_select with annotated support IDs, privileged selection oracle without new answer text
evaluation.secondary: Canonical F1, separately attributed mirror-alias EM/F1, unsupported counts, support selection precision/recall, full gold-answer span LL with EOS separate, existing ordinary-source NLL panel, generated tokens, measured latency and accelerator time. Report all arms and controls together.
evaluation.cost: Record reserved chip-hours, target-label counts and native generated actions separately. Serving latency requires sequential, warmed, same-shape timing; concurrent wall times are not a controlled latency comparison.
evaluation.interpretation: No post-answer/internalization, general pretraining, capacity-scaling or ordinary-CoT superiority claim is tested. A positive pointer effect is evidence-selection assistance under this recipe. A negative result closes this pilot, not all possible reasoning supervision.

release_requirements: Exact source and fresh-panel hashes, independently checked directed exclusions and no truncation
All TRAIN native target views fit the fixed packing; exact source/final-label and coefficient equality
Dense CPU loss/gradient parity for three separately normalized components; no future labels enter policy prompts
Actual same-source/same-shape new-objective update and full-state restore qualification with finite memory and preserved failures
Concrete serial review of the two-arm run binding and resource budget before jobs exceeding one accelerator-hour; no user permission needed within existing authorization
